Global admin can set tenant license/seat limits and see license usage.

Tenant admin can invite users only within their own tenant and only within license limits.
Tenant admin can approve or revoke invited tenant users according to tenant policy, but cannot exceed licenses or grant global admin access.
Tenant admin can manage tenant-specific account settings, broker/client/user access, tenant integration credentials, signing preferences, and tenant package/default preferences where allowed.
Tenant admin cannot mutate global NMAR templates, global template versions, global provider catalogs, or other tenants.
OAuth-created users remain in a pending/onboarding state unless matched to an invite or approved by the correct tenant admin/global admin path.
Role and RLS model clearly distinguishes global_admin, tenant_admin, tc, broker, buyer, seller, title, mortgage, and any future tenant-scoped roles.
Audit events record tenant creation, tenant admin changes, license changes, invitations, approvals, revocations, and rejected over-license invites.
